features.name: Actor
features.flavor: A charismatic performer who excels at deception and entertainment, perfect for bards, sorcerers, and social rogues.

effects.note: You gain proficiency in Deception or Performance, and you gain a +5 bonus to whichever you choose. You also gain advantage on Charisma (Performance) checks when you are trying to impress a crowd.

features.summary: +5 to Deception or Performance, and advantage impressing a crowd
features.text: You gain proficiency in Deception or Performance, and you gain a +5 bonus to whichever you choose. You also gain advantage on Charisma (Performance) checks when you are trying to impress a crowd.

features.name: Athlete
features.flavor: A nimble climber, jumper, and swimmer who uses athleticism to overcome physical obstacles. Ideal for martial characters who need mobility.

effects.note: You gain proficiency in Athletics. Your long jump can be up to a number of feet equal to 3 times your Strength score, and your jump distance is multiplied by your long jump distance. From 18th level, you gain proficiency in climbing and swimming.

features.summary: Proficiency in Athletics; long jump scales with Strength
features.text: You gain proficiency in Athletics. Your long jump can be up to a number of feet equal to 3 times your Strength score, and you gain proficiency in climbing and swimming.

features.name: Heavily Armored
features.flavor: A heavily armored warrior who gains proficiency with heavy armor. Requires medium armor proficiency.

effects.note: You gain proficiency with heavy armor. While you are wearing heavy armor, your speed is reduced by 10 feet.

features.summary: Proficiency with heavy armor, at 10 ft less speed while worn
features.text: You gain proficiency with heavy armor. While you are wearing heavy armor, your speed is reduced by 10 feet.

features.name: Lightly Armored

effects.note: You gain proficiency with light armor and medium armor. While you are wearing light armor or medium armor, your speed is reduced by 5 feet.

features.summary: Proficiency with light and medium armor, at 5 ft less speed
features.text: You gain proficiency with light armor and medium armor. While you are wearing light armor or medium armor, your speed is reduced by 5 feet.

features.name: Moderately Armored
features.flavor: A medium armor user who gains medium armor proficiency and shields. Requires light armor proficiency.

effects.note: You gain proficiency with light armor and medium armor. When you gain proficiency with armor, you gain proficiency with shields.

features.summary: Proficiency with light and medium armor, and with shields
features.text: You gain proficiency with light armor and medium armor, and with shields.

features.name: Heavy Armor Master
features.flavor: A juggernaut in heavy armor who reduces incoming damage. Requires heavy armor proficiency.

effects.note: While you are wearing heavy armor, you gain the following benefits: If you move more than 5 feet and then hit a creature with a melee attack on the same turn, you can make one additional attack. That attack is made at a disadvantage unless you already have the Grave or Slasher feat.

features.summary: Hit after moving 5+ ft: a second attack at disadvantage
features.text: While you are wearing heavy armor, if you move more than 5 feet and then hit a creature with a melee attack on the same turn, you can make one additional attack. That attack is made at a disadvantage.

features.name: Medium Armor Master
features.flavor: A medium armor specialist who eliminates stealth penalties and increases AC. Great for medium armor users.

effects.note: While you are wearing medium armor, if you move more than 5 feet and then hit a creature with a melee attack on the same turn, you can make one additional attack, at a disadvantage unless you have the Grave or Slasher feat.

features.summary: In medium armor: move 5+ ft then hit, extra attack at disadvantage
features.text: While you are wearing medium armor, if you move more than 5 feet and then hit a creature with a melee attack on the same turn, you can make one additional attack, at a disadvantage unless you have the Grave or Slasher feat.

features.name: Observant
features.flavor: A keen observer who notices details others miss. Great for investigators, rogues, and watchful characters.

effects.note: Your passive Wisdom (Perception) score is increased by 5.

features.summary: +1 to Investigation and Perception; passive Perception up 5
features.text: Your passive Wisdom (Perception) score is increased by 5.

features.name: Inspiring Leader
features.flavor: A charismatic commander who bolsters their allies with temporary hit points. Great for party faces and support characters.

effects.note: You can take a bonus action to inspire up to five willing creatures within 30 feet of you, each of whom gains temporary hit points equal to 1d8 plus your Charisma modifier. A creature can be inspired only once, and the effect ends when you finish a long rest or when you use this again.

features.summary: Bonus action: give five allies 1d8 + Cha temp HP
features.text: You can take a bonus action to inspire up to five willing creatures within 30 feet of you, each of whom gains temporary hit points equal to 1d8 plus your Charisma modifier.

features.name: Mage Slayer
features.flavor: A anti-mage specialist who disrupts spellcasters in melee. Essential for martial characters facing magic-heavy enemies.

effects.note: When you damage a creature with a melee attack, if it is concentrating on a spell, you can use your reaction to force it to make a Constitution saving throw. It takes half damage on a success and concentration on a failure. At 17th level you can also do this when a creature within 30 feet of you that you can see damages you.
When a creature within 30 feet of you that you can see damages you, you can use your reaction to force it to make a Constitution saving throw; half damage on a success and concentration on a failure.

features.summary: Reaction: break a caster's concentration when you melee it
features.text: When you damage a creature with a melee attack, if it is concentrating on a spell, you can use your reaction to force it to make a Constitution saving throw. It takes half damage on a success and concentration on a failure.

features.name: Polearm Master
features.flavor: A master of polearm combat who controls the battlefield with reach weapons. Essential for polearm fighters and paladins.

effects.note: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can make one melee weapon attack using a quarterstaff, a spear, or a short/long glaive as a bonus action. That attack can be used only to make one of the following, and it must be made before or after your regular attack: a shove, or a grapple attempt. If you hit with it, you can instead make an attack with a quarterstaff, a spear or a glaive as a bonus action.

features.summary: Bonus action: shove, or an extra glaive or spear attack
features.text: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can make one melee weapon attack using a quarterstaff, a spear, or a short or long glaive as a bonus action. You can use this bonus action only to make one of the following: a shove attempt, or a grapple attempt. If you hit a creature with this attack, you can instead make one attack with a quarterstaff, a spear or a glaive as a bonus action on your next turn.

features.name: Sentinel
features.flavor: A defender who locks down enemies with opportunity attacks. Perfect for tanks who want to protect allies.

effects.note: You gain the following benefits when you hit a creature with an attack: If the creature is hit by an attack by another creature, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against that creature. Creatures within your reach have disadvantage on opportunity attack rolls against you, and you can use a reaction to make an opportunity attack when a creature moves out of your reach.

features.summary: Attack a second creature that attacked your target; allies don't provoke you
features.text: You gain the following benefits when you hit a creature with an attack. If the creature is hit by an attack by another creature, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against that creature. Creatures within your reach have disadvantage on opportunity attack rolls against you.

features.name: Skilled
features.flavor: A jack-of-all-trades who gains proficiency in three skills or tools. Great for rounding out a character's abilities.
features.summary: Proficiency in three skills of your choice
features.text: You gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice.

features.name: Slasher
features.flavor: A brutal attacker who slows and bleeds enemies with slashing weapons. Great for martial characters who want to control.

effects.note: When you hit a creature with a slashing weapon, you can give either yourself or the creature disadvantage on all ability checks until the start of your next turn, and you can also make an additional attack using a bonus action on your next turn.

features.summary: On a slashing hit: something gains disadvantage; bonus attack next turn
features.text: When you hit a creature with a slashing weapon, you can give either yourself or the creature disadvantage on all ability checks until the start of your next turn. You can also make an additional attack using a bonus action on your next turn.

features.name: Tough
features.flavor: A durable survivor with extra hit points that scale with level. Essential for front-line characters who need more HP.
features.summary: Hit point maximum increases by twice your character level
features.text: Your hit point maximum increases by 2 at 1st level, and by 2 more every level after that, so at 20th level you gain 40 hit points.

features.name: Spell Sniper

requires.note: The ability to cast at least one spell

features.flavor: A spellcaster who doubles spell range and ignores cover. Requires ability to cast at least one spell.

effects.note: When you make an attack roll for a ranged spell, you ignore half cover and three-quarters cover, and if you hit, you can add your Charisma modifier, Intelligence modifier or Wisdom modifier to the damage. You also gain the benefits of the Archery fighting style.

features.summary: +1 ranged spell attack, ignore half cover, and a stat to damage
features.text: When you make an attack roll for a ranged spell, you ignore half cover and three-quarters cover, and if you hit, you can add your Charisma modifier, Intelligence modifier or Wisdom modifier to the damage. You also gain the benefits of the Archery fighting style.

features.name: Squat Nimbleness
features.flavor: A dwarf or small race with surprising agility, gaining AC bonus and climbing speed. Perfect for small martial characters.

effects.note: You can move at your normal speed through a space occupied by a creature of your size or smaller whose movement is reduced to 0 by difficult terrain, without having difficulty on movement or triggering its opportunity attack.

features.summary: Move through difficult terrain without difficulty
features.text: You can move at your normal speed through a space occupied by a creature of your size or smaller whose movement is reduced to 0 by difficult terrain, without having difficulty on movement or triggering its opportunity attack.

features.name: Mobile
features.flavor: A swift striker who excels at hit-and-run tactics. Perfect for rogues, monks, and skirmishers.

effects.note: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can move up to 10 feet, without provoking opportunity attacks, whether or not the creature is hit. You also gain the benefits of the Two-Weapon Fighting fighting style.

features.summary: +10 speed; move after a melee hit without provoking attacks
features.text: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can move up to 10 feet, without provoking opportunity attacks, whether or not the creature is hit. You also gain the benefits of the Two-Weapon Fighting fighting style.

features.name: Tavern Brawler
features.flavor: A tough fighter who excels in unarmed combat and improvised weapons. Great for monks, barbarians, and brawlers.

effects.note: You have learned to fight in a tavern brawl: you gain proficiency with improvised weapons. When you hit a creature with an improvised weapon, you can use a bonus action to attempt to redirect the creature's attack, as a reaction, by making an attack roll against the creature's AC; on a hit, the creature must use a different target for its attack.

features.summary: Proficiency with improvised weapons; BA attack and redirect
features.text: You have learned to fight in a tavern brawl: you gain proficiency with improvised weapons. When you hit a creature with an improvised weapon, you can use a bonus action to attempt to redirect the creature's attack, as a reaction, by making an attack roll against the creature's AC.

features.name: War Caster

requires.note: The ability to cast at least one spell

features.flavor: A spellcaster who can cast spells as opportunity attacks and maintain concentration. Requires ability to cast at least one spell.

effects.note: You have learned to make a spell attack in the middle of a melee fight. You gain the following benefits: your spell save DC is increased by 1, you can cast a spell with one hand without somatic or material components, and you can use a reaction to cast a spell when a creature moves within 10 feet of you that would leave its reach.

features.summary: +1 spell save DC; component-free casting; reaction on movement
features.text: You gain the following benefits: your spell save DC is increased by 1, you can cast a spell with one hand without somatic or material components, and you can use a reaction to cast a spell when a creature moves within 10 feet of you that would leave its reach.
